user.title: Triad AMS audio matrix
user.description: Adding the amp only reads it. Nothing is written until you switch to control mode in the options.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the amp on that address and port.

abort.already_configured: This amp is already set up.

init.title: Triad AMS
init.description: Current mode: {mode}. Monitor = read only (Control4 owns the amp). Control = Home Assistant drives the amp.

menu_options.control: Take control (Home Assistant drives the amp)
menu_options.monitor: Roll back to monitor only (Control4 keeps control)

control.title: Take control of the amp
control.description: A snapshot of every room's source, volume and mute is saved first. Keep Control4 audio idle while HA controls the amp: two controllers writing at once will fight.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: One room per line as output=Name, outputs 1-24. Example: 5=Kitchen

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: One source per line as input=Name, inputs 1-24. Example: 5=WiiM Ultra

data.default_input: Default input when a room is switched on

error.invalid_map: Use one 'number=Name' per line with numbers 1-24.
error.default_not_in_sources: The default input must be one of the listed sources.

abort.snapshot_failed: Could not read the amp to take the safety snapshot, so control mode was not enabled.

snapshot.name: Save snapshot
snapshot.description: Save source, volume and mute of every room (read only).

restore_snapshot.name: Restore snapshot
restore_snapshot.description: Put every room back as in the last snapshot.

all_off.name: All off
all_off.description: Switch every room to Audio Off.

party.name: Party
party.description: Send every room to one input.
